name: Concerted Efforts
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
We're not fighting isolated battles against the Horde anymore,  lad.

Victory in one front means denying the Horde resources they'd use against us in a different battle.  By the same token, losing any given battle could give the advantage to our opponent somewhere else around the world.

The Alliance is in need of more combatants with this sort of worldly understanding... truly seasoned veterans!  adventurer, come back to me after you've served against the Horde at all of our active battlegrounds.
narrative.objectives: Bring 3 Alterac Valley Mark of Honor, 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor and 3 Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor to an Alliance Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You're not one to disappoint, adventurer! What you've learned goes beyond petty medals and commendations. What you've learned is what can only come with experience and the hardening of one's temper in the field of battle.

You've done well, Champion. You're a true hero of the Alliance!
narrative.requestItemsText: How are yer travels faring laddie?
